title: Paired-N audit across ALL objectives — true trainable/validatable N (matched feature+label pairs)
principle: paired-N = count of matched (model-input-feature, objective-label) pairs. Label count alone is NOT the metric. Where a modality is held only as RAW (no processed features) or only as a manifest (no landed data), the CURRENTLY-COMPUTABLE paired-N is lower than the EXISTS-PUBLICLY paired-N; both are reported.

objectives.name: transcriptional perturbation response
objectives.feature: baseline / control cell state (pre-perturbation transcriptome, or NTC/vehicle control cells)
objectives.label: post-perturbation expression (perturb-seq / CRISPR / drug / cytokine)
objectives.join_logic: pairing is INTRINSIC to each perturb-seq dataset: within one experiment, control (NTC/vehicle) cells provide the baseline feature and perturbed cells provide the label; the (perturbation-id, cell-context) is the pairing key. No cross-dataset join needed. paired-N counted as (perturbation x cell-context) conditions with a matched control, and separately as perturbed cells.

datasets.Tahoe-100M: 95.6M perturbation-labeled cells, 50 cancer lines x ~1,100 compounds (~60k drug x line conditions), vehicle controls in-dataset. HELD in full (429 GB).
datasets.Replogle-Nadig (DE): 4 lines x ~2,000 gene KDs, DE vs NTC precomputed. HELD (36 GB).
datasets.CZI genome-scale T-cell Perturb-seq (GWC: primary human CD4+ T, 18,129 genes perturbed, ~22M cells, rest/8h/48h, NTC controls; pseudobulk_merged + DE_stats HELD (~107 GB of h5ad/h5mu).

paired_N_currently_computable.estimate: >100M perturbed cells; ~70k+ (perturbation x cell-context) matched-control conditions across held corpora

objectives.gap: Not a data gap for H1. This is the ONE objective with an abundant, same-experiment paired training corpus already on S3. Caveat: cell contexts are dominated by cancer lines (Tahoe) + primary CD4 T (CZI); immune cell-type coverage beyond T cells is thinner. Perturbation-response pairing does not require the H2-H4 cross-modal join.

objectives.name: translation efficiency
objectives.label: ribo-seq (RPF / translation), same sample
objectives.join_logic: pair = (RNA-seq, Ribo-seq) from the SAME biological sample -> translation efficiency TE = RPF/mRNA. Join key = sample identity within a study that ran both assays.

paired_N_currently_computable.note: ZERO Ribo-seq held on S3 (confirmed). No matched RNA+Ribo sample landed.

paired_N_exists_publicly.estimate: ~1,054 human matched RNA+Ribo-seq samples (RiboBase TE-ready subset); RPFdb v3.0 independently reports 2,343 matched RNA-seq alongside 5,018 Ribo-seq. Best human TE-ready estimate ~1,000-2,300 same-sample pairs.
paired_N_exists_publicly.immune-context subset: essentially 0 on any HLA-typed immune line under a matched perturbation; IFN-gamma Ribo-seq exists ONLY on primary human macrophages (Su 2015) with no matched immunopeptidome. In the perturbation-matched multimodal inventory, 4-layer (T+R+P+L) sets = 1 identified (PXD013649, melanoma/lung +IFN-gamma with exome+RNA+Ribo) but NOT held.
paired_N_exists_publicly.confidence: medium (public scale from RiboBase/RPFdb; immune-subset from literature sweep)

objectives.gap: BIGGEST H2-H4 GAP. The matched-sample TE layer is (a) 0 held, (b) exists publicly at ~1-2k generic human pairs but is near-absent on immune/HLA-typed contexts, (c) as a perturbation-matched cross-modal layer aligned with H1/H3/H4 it is effectively 1 identified set (PXD013649). To count exactly: fetch RiboBase/RPFdb matched pairs and intersect sample metadata with RNA availability; but immune-relevant matched TE requires generation.

objectives.name: protein abundance
objectives.feature: transcriptome (mRNA), same sample / same cell line
objectives.label: proteome (shotgun / DIA / TMT MS abundance), same sample / same cell line
objectives.join_logic: pair = (transcriptome, proteome) for the SAME cell line or SAME tumor sample. Same-flask pairs are strongest; cell-line-level pairs (CCLE RNA joined to ProCan/CCLE proteome by DepMap/Cellosaurus ID) are cross-study but valid for cell-line abundance modeling.

paired_N_currently_computable.value_same_flask_held: ~2 (PXD023038 MDA-MB-231 IFN-neg/pos DIA proteome held as RAW ONLY, no processed protein matrix; must be searched. CCLE basal transcriptome held (DepMap TPM), proteome NOT held).
paired_N_currently_computable.note: Proteome held only as RAW .raw files (PXD023038, ~32 GB); no processed protein-abundance matrix landed -> currently-computable same-flask paired-N is ~0 until the RAW is searched. Transcriptome side (CCLE/DepMap TPM) IS held.

paired_N_exists_publicly.estimate: ~950-1,000 distinct human cancer cell lines with BOTH deep MS proteome (ProCan 949 lines / CCLE-Nusinow 375 lines) AND CCLE transcriptome -> ~950-1,000 cell-line-level (RNA,protein) pairs joinable via DepMap ID. Plus >1,000 CPTAC tumors with matched RNA+protein (same-sample).

objectives.gap: Proteome corpus is NOT held (only 1 IFN-gamma set's RAW). Cell-line RNA-proteome pairing is cross-study (different flasks) except CPTAC (same-sample tumors). To count exactly-held: search PXD023038 RAW to a protein matrix (only 1 line) OR fetch ProCan PXD030304 + CCLE-Nusinow and join to DepMap TPM (~950 lines, cross-study). Immune-line same-flask RNA+proteome under perturbation is thin (folds into the H4 triads below).

objectives.name: antigen presentation (immunopeptidome)
objectives.feature: proteome/perturbation-transcriptome (machinery-state: PSMB8/9/10, TAP1/2, TAPBP, ERAP1/2, B2M, CIITA, HLA-A/B/C...) + HLA genotype, same cell context
objectives.label: immunopeptidome (eluted-ligand peptide-HLA MS), same cell context
objectives.join_logic: pair = (cell-context x perturbation x HLA-genotype) triple for which BOTH a machinery-state feature (from held T and/or P) AND an eluted-ligand MS readout co-exist. HLA genotype supplied by TCLP (1,082 lines, 4-digit) via DepMap/Cellosaurus ID. Strongest = same-flask co-deposited multimodal; relaxed = cross-study CCLE join.

paired_N_currently_computable.value_held: 1 immunopeptidome set landed with matched feature: PXD056426 (HAP1 11-gene APM-KO, 12 conditions, each KO vs WT with matched bulk proteome) -> H4 kill-test PASS (B2M-KO -> 2% surface). PXD054491 (ERAP1-KO) also held. HLA Ligand Atlas held (223,246 peptides, benign reference, unperturbed).
paired_N_currently_computable.note: The tracks/immunopeptidome manifest is 2-4 KB manifest-ONLY (dead IEDB/HLA-Atlas URLs) -> no bulk landed L data beyond PXD056426/PXD054491 + HLA Ligand Atlas. Proteome/transcriptome feature side for those held L sets IS present (HAP1 matched proteome in-deposit; CCLE RNA for lines).
paired_N_currently_computable.confidence: high (S3-verified: PXD056426, PXD054491, HLA_Ligand_Atlas held; proteome_raw only PXD023038; immunopeptidome tracks = manifest only)

perturbation_matched_same_flask.>=2 modalities: 4 co-deposited sets (GRANTA-519/PXD020750 T+P+L; MDA-MB-231/PXD023038+44 P+L; melanoma panel/PXD017407+GSE144373 T+P+L; UWB.1.289/PXD006939 L-only)
perturbation_matched_same_flask.>=3 modalities (T+P+L, H2->H4 trainers): 3 (GRANTA-519, melanoma panel, MDA-MB-231-via-CCLE-RNA); 1 (GRANTA-519/PXD020750) is a clean single-deposit T+P+L+HLA prize
perturbation_matched_same_flask.causal machinery-KO -> presentation (mat: ~29 verified perturbation-paired immunopeptidome studies identified (HAP1 APM-panel PXD056426 held; ERAP1/2, B2M, TAPBP/TAPBPR, CIITA KO cluster; DNMTi/HDACi/MEKi/AZA drug arms; ONX-0914 immunoproteasome-inhibitor MSV000091285) -- identified/verified, mostly NOT held

paired_N_exists_publicly.baseline_relaxed_cross_study: hundreds of (cell-context x HLA) >=2-modality pairs via CCLE RNA (~1,000 lines) + Nusinow proteome (375 lines) joined to SysteMHC v2.0 (89 studies / 2,447 samples / 303 allotypes) / caAtlas (311) / B721.221 mono-allelic (95 alleles). Cross-study, not same-flask.

objectives.gap: Held paired H4 training data = 1-2 causal-KO sets (PXD056426, PXD054491) + benign reference. The perturbation-matched paired immunopeptidome layer that EXISTS publicly (~3 T+P+L triads + ~29 causal-KO sets) is enough to build the pipeline and run the IFN-gamma kill-test, NOT enough to be a generalizing training corpus -> Tier-2 CRO generation required. Immunopeptidome (L) is the least-held modality (manifest-only). To count exactly-held: fetch PXD020750/023044/017407 + the causal-KO cluster; then paired-N = triads landed.

objectives.name: vaccine immune response (baseline transcriptome -> seroconversion)
objectives.label: seroconversion / response (HAI / titer fold-change) from ImmPort
objectives.join_logic: subject -> biosample -> expsample -> expsample_public_repository (GEO/SRA) for a BASELINE transcriptome AND subject has a measured pre/post titer response label. Pair = subject with both.
objectives.gap: Label count (6,819) vastly exceeds paired-N (2,125): only 31% of vaccine-response subjects have a linked baseline transcriptome. dbGaP links excluded (controlled genotype, not transcriptome). This 2,125 is the real validatable N for 'predict response from baseline immune state'.

objectives.name: safety / adverse-event prediction (molecular feature -> clinical AE)
objectives.feature: molecular feature (transcriptome) linked to the AE-bearing subject/arm
objectives.label: adverse-event outcome: arm-level AE rate with denominator (ImmPort adverse_event x arm roster)
objectives.join_logic: LABEL side: subject rostered to an arm in an AE-collecting study (297 arms, 107 studies, 16,516 subjects). FEATURE side: same subject -> biosample -> expsample -> expsample_public_repository transcriptome link. Pair = subject with BOTH an AE label AND a transcriptome feature. (Arm-level alternative: arm has both an AE rate and >=1 transcriptome-linked subject.)

label_only_N.note: This is LABEL-ONLY. It is NOT the trainable/validatable paired-N.

paired_N_detail.note: 1,240 AE-labeled subjects also carry a public-repo (GEO/SRA) expsample link; 1,047 after excluding 193 subjects whose linked biosample material is DNA (genotype/exome, not expression). All 1,240 are GEO/SRA/ENA (none dbGaP-only). Accession prefixes: GSM 2,501 + SRX 207 (sample-level, not series-level).

objectives.source: ImmPort tables_parquet join: (adverse_event x arm_2_subject roster) INTERSECT (subject->biosample->expsample_2_biosample->expsample_public_repository), computed W1
objectives.confidence: high on the join; MEDIUM on the exact transcriptome count (per-GSM assay type RNA-seq vs methylation/miRNA/scRNA not verified against GEO -> 1,047 is an upper bound on true RNA-expression pairs)
objectives.gap: Safety paired-N is ~1,047-1,240 subjects across 9-10 studies -- an ORDER OF MAGNITUDE below the 16,516 label-only denominator (label count is 13-16x the paired-N). Concentrated in a few studies (SDY1880/1903/1402/1490). To count exactly: verify each of the 2,708 GSM/SRX accessions is an expression assay (vs methylation/genotype). Still a real, if modest, safety-validation set.

objectives.name: therapy duration / sustained response (molecular feature -> time-to-event)
objectives.feature: molecular feature (baseline transcriptome / covariates) of the withdrawal-cohort patient
objectives.label: time-to-event: biopsy-proven rejection after immunosuppression withdrawal (iWITH / SDY1490)
objectives.join_logic: patient with a withdrawal time-to-event label AND a matched molecular feature. Current held label cohort (iWITH) = clinical/covariate only.

label_only_N.aggregate_trial_withdrawal_arms: RA 194 + asthma 104 + lupus 43 usable aggregate trials (arm-level withdrawal/durability evidence, ClinicalTrials.gov) -- NOT patient time-to-event, NOT molecular-linked

objectives.paired_N_detail: iWITH (n=88 patients, 40 events) has clinical covariates only -- NO transcriptome/molecular feature landed for these patients. The aggregate RA/asthma/lupus trial arms are label-only aggregates with no per-patient molecular feature. => molecular-feature -> duration-outcome paired-N = 0.
objectives.gap: BIGGEST DURATION GAP: paired molecular-feature -> duration-outcome N = 0. iWITH gives a real 88-patient/40-event clinical time-to-event cohort but with only age/sex/history covariates, no expression. To get a nonzero molecular paired-N, must locate a withdrawal/tolerance cohort with baseline transcriptomes (e.g. iWITH biosamples linked to GEO, or a different tolerance study) -- not present in current holdings.

H4_presentation.paired_N_public: ~3 T+P+L triads + ~29 causal-KO sets; hundreds cross-study baseline
